title: Insurance Claim Services Credited Value: How the Write-Off Amount Is Figured
content:
**Clause.** The credited value of an Insurance Claim Services credited-line write-off takes every credit recorded on the Water Damage Mitigation job — its billing error, duplicate line and goodwill credits — and every change order credit posted on the Reconstruction contract, at their recorded amounts and the company's own prices. That sum is converted to the carrier's approval by scaling it by the initial dwelling approval over the estimate amount submitted when the approval is below the estimate, because the carrier approved every line at that share; when the approval is at or above the estimate amount the credited value stands. The result is held to the approval line's amount less earlier write-offs of it, and rounded to the cent, half up, once, on the final figure.

**Rounding.** Half up is applied with a tolerance of one billionth of a dollar (1e-09) added before the single rounding.

## Quantities and their records

| Quantity | Record |
|---|---|
| water job credits | the billing error, duplicate line and goodwill adjustment credits on the water job |
| contract credits | the change order credits posted on the reconstruction contract |
| initial dwelling approval | the carrier's initial scope approval on the dwelling coverage of the claim file |
| estimate amount | the estimate amount submitted on the claim file |
| earlier write-offs | the write-offs already posted against the initial dwelling approval line |

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

Water job credits of 420.00 and change order credits of 1180.00 give 1600.00. With an initial dwelling approval of 27000.00 against an estimate of 30000.00, the share is 0.9 and the credited value is 1440.00; with no earlier write-off on a 27000.00 approval line the write-off is **1440.00**. Had the approval been 30500.00, at or above the estimate, the credited value would stand at 1600.00. A credited value of 1440.00 against an approval line with only 1000.00 left after earlier write-offs is held to **1000.00**.
